notes.title: N-Age Online: Awakening 2nd Anniversary Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/6ef8a4c8bc5fdeaebc842aa769fc41efe92e1554.jpg[/img]

Greetings Students!

Welcome to the 2nd Anniversary Celebration of N-Age Online: Awakening! Today marks a special moment as we celebrate the amazing memories, epic battles, and strong bonds we've built together throughout the journey. This event is our way of showing deep appreciation to each of you for being an essential part of the N-Age story.

Let's hop into the 2nd anniversary updates!

[b]■ Patch Content:[/b]
➤ Lucky Box icon modification
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/ac0720d0b125aa7bb4e464c73941185c28bbec5c.png[/img]

➤ Carrying out work to improve the stabilization of the server

[b]■ Update:[/b]
➤ Wing animation has been added to the wing equipment, which has an enhancement level of +10 and above.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/1f8070f28675b5c7dbd14c23663cb99d80f82324.gif[/img]

➤ Summer Theme update will be implemented in Bourbon and Liberty maps.
➤ WSS Lucky Roulette update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b161d4863ff0cbbd8c0b52cb0f015d406173dcec.png[/img]

➤ Hip-hop concept costume set
➤ Hip-hop concept board mount
➤ [Royal] SP Hair

[b]■ Events[/b]
➤ Anniversary Hot-Time Event
Event Duration: May 30 - June 1, 2025, and June 6 - 8, 2025
Time: 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM GMT+7 (12 hours every day)
[list]
[*] EXP Boost +100%
[*] Fame EXP Boost +50%
[*] Durability Consumption -20%
[*] Skill EXP Boost +50%
[*] AP +20%
[/list]
➤ Field Hunting Event
Required Level: Level 50 or above
[list]
[*] Go to Borbon Fountain Square and look for the Chorangi NPC (X: 242 Y:424)
[*] Click Mission to activate the event.
[/list]

[b]NOTE: Make sure to accept the Anniversary Event mission for the event items to drop.[/b]

➤ Gift Exchange Event
[list]
[*] Collect 1 million gold coins and x5 Quest Cards and exchange them for a Thank You Gift Box.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/3c50d23c39606a5fd53b3b18e4e40136591fd0ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/7612bda9d552bebe425ef1174665ca450528e32c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/64aaf98e5924970ac2db37561eac7e63b36e5bc6.png[/img]

➤ Boss Monster Assault Event

Period: After maintenance on May 27, 2025 – Before maintenance on June 24, 2025
Required Level:100 and above

[list]
[*] During the event period, the boss monster "Intrusion Justice" will appear in Cinder Square, and defeating it will drop various rewards.
[*] You can receive the Intrusion Justice hunting event quest from the Blue Verti NPC (X:242 Y:430) in Bourbon Village.
[/list]
Completing the quest is required to receive additional rewards.

➤ Returning User Event
[b]Period:[/b] After maintenance on May 27, 2025 – Before maintenance on June 24, 2025
[b]Eligible Returning Users:[/b] Users who have not logged in for at least 14 days (latest logout date must be before May 13, 2025)
Rewards: 

[b]NOTE: Only the first character to log in per account will receive the reward.[/b]

➤ Lucky Coupon Spending Bonus Event
Period: After maintenance on May 27, 2025 –  June 03, 2025
[list]
[*] For every 3000 Gcoins, you get two Lucky Coupons. A total of 30 Lucky Coupons can be acquired.
[*] Rewards can be claimed in the "Event" tab.
[/list]
[b]■ Products
[/b]➤ Lucky Roulette modification

We want to thank each and every one of you for making N-Age Online: Awakening such a vibrant and unforgettable community. Your passion, dedication, and spirit are what keep this world alive and thriving. The adventure continues — and we can’t wait to share what’s next with you!

Your N-Age Awakening GM Team 🌟
